name: Notion AI
tagline: AI writing and Q&A add-on built into the Notion workspace
painPoints: Requires a paid Business plan to get unlimited AI access
AI is confined to Notion — it cannot read your email, calendar, or external tools
AI features are writing-assistance and Q&A focused, not proactive or action-taking
Every AI action still starts with you — nothing happens automatically
No task automation, scheduling, or workflow execution across apps
metaDescription: Looking for a Notion AI alternative? GAIA is source-available AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across your tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: Notion AI brought AI writing, summarization, and Q&A into the Notion workspace, but it remains siloed within Notion. It cannot see your unread emails, does not know about your upcoming meetings, and cannot create tasks or schedule events on your behalf. To get unlimited Notion AI, you now need the paid Business plan — and you still end up with an AI that only works inside one app. Users looking for a Notion AI alternative typically want an assistant that is genuinely proactive and connected across their entire digital workflow, not just their Notion workspace.
gaiaReplaces: AI-powered Q&A over your notes and knowledge base via semantic memory
Automatic meeting note capture linked to calendar events
Email triage and drafting with full Gmail context
Cross-tool task creation without manual Notion database entry
Workflow automation beyond Notion's database triggers
gaiaAdvantages: Works across Gmail, Google Calendar, Todoist, and the rest of your tools: not just one app
Proactive by design: surfaces what needs attention without prompting
Source-available and self-hostable; Notion AI is a closed, proprietary feature
Free tier available; no per-seat Business plan required
Graph-based memory connects context across all your tools automatically
migrationSteps: Export key Notion pages as Markdown and ingest into GAIA's memory system
Connect GAIA to Gmail and Google Calendar via OAuth
Set up GAIA's proactive inbox monitoring to replace manual Notion AI queries
Use GAIA's conversational interface for Q&A instead of Notion AI search

faqs.question: Can GAIA answer questions about my notes like Notion AI?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA uses semantic search over its graph-based memory to answer questions about your notes, emails, meetings, and tasks. You can import Notion exports into GAIA's memory for full Q&A capability.

faqs.question: Is GAIA cheaper than getting Notion AI via the Business plan?
faqs.answer: Notion's Business plan, which includes unlimited AI, is a paid per-seat plan. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month for an individual but includes email management, calendar integration, tool connections, and workflow automation — not just AI writing inside one app. Self-hosted GAIA is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs).

faqs.question: Does GAIA write content and summarize documents like Notion AI?
faqs.answer: GAIA can draft emails, summarize email threads, and generate content from your calendar and task context. For long-form document editing inside a rich text editor, Notion AI's in-document writing experience is more specialized.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work outside of a single workspace like Notion AI does?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's intelligence spans Gmail, Google Calendar, Todoist, and dozens of other tools simultaneously. It is not limited to one workspace or one application.

comparisonRows.gaia: Assistant across Gmail, Calendar, Todoist, and the rest of your tools, not intelligence confined to one workspace
comparisonRows.competitor: In-workspace AI assistant embedded in the Notion editor: writes, summarises, translates, and autofills databases on demand inside Notion

comparisonRows.gaia: Email triage and drafting with full Gmail context, where Notion AI has no inbox visibility at all
comparisonRows.competitor: No email integration: Notion AI has no visibility into your inbox and cannot read, triage, or act on emails

comparisonRows.gaia: Calendar read, managed, and briefed automatically, beyond a workspace with no calendar awareness
comparisonRows.competitor: No calendar integration: Notion AI cannot read your Google Calendar, create events, or prepare meeting context automatically

comparisonRows.gaia: Agents that execute across external tools from email to tasks, not only across pages in one app
comparisonRows.competitor: Autonomous agents (since Notion 3.0) that execute multi-step tasks across Notion pages: powerful within Notion but isolated to the workspace

comparisonRows.gaia: Surfaces what needs attention without prompting by monitoring external context continuously
comparisonRows.competitor: Reactive: Notion AI acts when you invoke it inside the editor; it does not monitor external context or act without being asked

comparisonRows.gaia: AI features extend across every connected tool, not fenced inside one ecosystem
comparisonRows.competitor: Operates within Notion's ecosystem; external integrations are available in Notion but AI features do not extend across those external tools

comparisonRows.gaia: Tasks created from external sources automatically with priorities, no database entry required
comparisonRows.competitor: Notion databases serve as task systems; AI can autofill properties and suggest priorities but does not create tasks from external sources automatically

comparisonRows.gaia: Source-available and self-hostable, unlike a closed proprietary feature
comparisonRows.competitor: Proprietary closed-source feature of Notion's commercial SaaS platform: no self-hosting available

comparisonRows.gaia: Free tier with no per-seat Business plan required; Pro from ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month; self-hosting free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs)
comparisonRows.competitor: Paid plans available; trial available; per-seat pricing.

comparisonRows.gaia: Graph-based memory connecting context across all tools automatically, beyond one workspace
comparisonRows.competitor: AI context is scoped to your Notion workspace: deep knowledge of Notion content but no awareness of external emails, calendar, or tool activity
